thread:
maya: Quick FYI — starting the tenant_id-schema migration in the 02:00 UTC quiet window. Deploybot will pin to runtime v1.9.4 and run the backfill job in 10-minute chunks. Preflight at :02:00:30, cutover at :02:10. @oncall-bot will page on errors.

deploybot: [automated] queued migration job mjob-2026-03-22-01 with pins: service-runtime=1.9.4, schema=tenant_id_v3. Estimated backfill rows: 4.3M. Canary batch size 10k. Notify @maya + @igor for holdpoints.

igor: Thanks — two quick asks: 1) Add explicit escape hatch to cancel the backfill without rolling the schema swap (we've had long-cancel times before). 2) Keep the old index around for 24h after swap in case of rollback.

maya: Agreed on both. Igor — can you paste the cancellation command for the runbook?

igor: Use the deploybot cancel flow:```bash
deploybot cancel mjob-2026-03-22-01 --grace 30s --skip-swap
```
That will stop the backfill workers and leave the schema unchanged. If we need full rollback (post-swap), we follow the DB-rollback runbook.

sam: Heads up — disable async-notify worker during the backfill window to avoid duplicate downstream writes. Add this flag in prod-worker config:```yaml
workers:
  async-notify:
    enabled: false
```
I'll open a quick PR to toggles.

lucy: I'll update the release notes: call out the quiet window, expected 5–8% latency bump on tenant API for ~5m, and the rollback command (igor's). Will add the owner contact (maya) and the cutover timeline.

maya: @deploybot please add a canary watch at 3 batches and auto-pause if error-rate > 1% or median p90 > 800ms.

deploybot: [automated] updated job mjob-2026-03-22-01: canary_watch_batches=3, pause_on_error_rate=0.01, pause_on_p90_ms=800. Will retry pause action up to 2x before paging.

oncall-bot: [runbook] migration checklist: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/db-migrations#tenant-id-swap. Page policy: error OR manual-pause OR >2 retries. On-call rotation: @igor -> @maya -> @sam.

sam: PR for the worker toggle opened: https://git.redwood/p/1234. Tagging @maya for quick approval.

maya: Approved. Sam — remember to rollout the toggle in the same quiet window as the migration (rollback-safe toggle).

igor: One more: add a short-lived feature-flag to route 1% of traffic to the new schema path for real traffic pre-cutover (sanity check). We'll kill it immediately if anything looks off.

maya: Good idea. Lucy— mention that flag in the notes (ff: tenant_v3_preview = 1%).

lucy: Done. Release notes draft: "Tenant ID schema v3 swap — quiet window 02:00 UTC. Canary + auto-pause on errors. Backfill cancel command included. Owner: @maya." Posting to docs in 5.

deploybot: [automated] preflight check scheduled at 7419876554: node-allocs OK, replicas healthy=98%, replication lag < 250ms.

maya: Preflight green. Proceeding to start canary batch in 30s. :party_parrot: 

igor: I'll watch the canary dashboard. If canary pauses, follow cancel flow then escalate to DB-leads.

lucy: Noting for legal/compliance: retention policy unaffected.

maya: If everything looks clean after 3 canary batches we do the full backfill. If paused, we follow igor's cancel and create a postmortem.

deploybot: [automated] canary batch 1 started at 7419876564 (10k rows). Logs: https://deploylogs/mjob-2026-03-22-01/1

sam: Observability note: I added an alert for duplicate-notify-rate > 0.5% to the migration dashboard.

oncall-bot: paging policy armed. Will escalate on auto-pause or deploybot retry failure.

maya: Thanks team. Will update thread with final outcome.

deploybot: [automated] canary batch 2 completed at 7419876570. error_rate=0.002, p90_ms=420. Continuing.

maya: Great — proceeding to full backfill in 2m unless anyone objects.

igor: No objections. Standing by.

lucy: Publishing release notes now.

maya: Closing the loop later with outcomes and perf numbers. :white_check_mark:
